Name: Glowing House Plants (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
This content pack adds house plant furniture items identical to the vanilla ones that function as lamps, to make lighting up your rooms easy without having to add tons of regular lamps. The plants still look normal when they light up, so they can just be used as normal house plants for decoration purposes. 

[b][size=4]Permissions[/size][/b]
There are no recolored versions of the plants available for this mod as of now. If you want to make your own recolor/retexture, translation, or make any other kind of change to this mod and post it, you are free to do so, as long as your mod is an add-on (using my mod as a dependency) and doesn't just copy/replace this one.


Enjoy!
